title: All of Us Research Program year in review: 2025.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: paper_context.py: no PMCID, no abstract, no full text, no supplement, no accessions, no NCBI links, no Zenodo/Dryad hits. HEAD on the All of Us registration page and public Data Browser (both HTTP 200); the browser serves only aggregate counts.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Nothing; the paper text was not retrievable. That individual-level All of Us data needs Researcher Workbench registration plus a data use agreement is known program policy, not read in this paper.

a1_downloadable.note: This is a program review article with no deposited dataset. All of Us individual-level data is controlled access: it requires Researcher Workbench registration, identity verification and a data use agreement, and cannot be downloaded.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Not checked; no dataset is attached to this paper and there is no defined label.

a5_enough_rows.note: No downloadable table; row count unknown.

a6_fits_laptop.note: Controlled data must be analysed inside the cloud Workbench, which breaks the laptop-only constraint.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Not checked; no files and no paper text.

honest_claim_h3: No claim possible: no downloadable data comes with this review article.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use participant genomes and health records to predict disease outcomes in a diverse United States cohort.
plain_idea.train_on: Individual genetic and health-record data from All of Us participants; number of examples unknown, since the data is controlled access.
plain_idea.predict: Disease diagnoses taken from electronic health records.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Diverse-ancestry prediction would matter, but the data can only be used inside a cloud workspace after an access application.

label_elsewhere.why: Not assessed because Part A failed.

ml_idea: None feasible under the constraints: the review has no attached dataset, and the All of Us data it describes is controlled access and cloud-only.

effort.cheapest_killing_check: Already done: access requires a Researcher Workbench registration and data use agreement.

verdict_reason: Review article with no dataset. The All of Us data it describes is controlled access (Researcher Workbench registration plus a data use agreement, cloud-only analysis), so A1 fails. Flagged as controlled access: All of Us Researcher Workbench.
